## Constitution check

- [ ] P1 Defensible Math: derived hours, dollars, ROI, or unit-economics changes are traceable and explainable.
- [ ] P2 Privacy by Default: no per-developer ranking, leaderboard, or surveillance affordance is introduced.
- [ ] P3 Read/Write Separation: the web app remains read-only and does not hold outbound GitHub credentials.
- [ ] P7 Contract-Driven Development: new or changed HTTP surfaces use ts-rest contracts.
- [ ] P8 Spec-First Changes: required spec updates are included.
- [ ] P10 OSS-First, Azure-Target: no phone-home telemetry, SaaS dependency, or external analytics collection is added.
